# cut

Published version: `cli/cut@0.2.7`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Select fields and byte positions for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/cut@0.2.7 (-b LIST | -c LIST | -f LIST [-d CHAR] [-s]) [--complement] [--output-delimiter=STRING] [-z] [FILE...]
```

## Supported scope

Select positions from files or stdin. Lists accept N, N-M, N- and -M; output preserves input order. The default field separator is TAB.

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-s` / `--only-delimited` | none | Skip undelimited records in field mode. |
| `-d` / `--delimiter` | required | Set the field delimiter; empty means NUL. |
| `-f` / `--fields` | required | Select fields. |
| `-b` / `--bytes` | required | Select bytes. |
| `-c` / `--characters` | required | Select characters under the C-byte profile. |
| `--complement` | none | Invert the selected positions. |
| `--output-delimiter` | required | Join selected fields/ranges; empty means NUL. |
| `-z` / `--zero-terminated` | none | Use NUL-delimited records. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

The published command uses delimiter searches and bounded contiguous projections; field selection and output-delimiter behavior are unchanged.

- -c counts bytes, not Unicode characters.
- -d and -s require field mode. Equal field and record delimiters make field positions span the input file.

## Examples

```sh
printf 'x,y,z\n' | moonx cli/cut@0.2.7 -d, -f1,3
moonx cli/cut@0.2.7 -b 1-4 fixed.txt
```
